Message:
Once upon a time,
there was a world teetering
on the brink of total destruction.

The animals who lived there
were full of distrust,
always bickering over
the smallest things.

Every day, they found
all sorts of ways to make
a mountain out of a molehill!

In the middle of all that chaos,
a single tortoise spoke up.

“If everyone’s having a hard time,
I want to help them.”
That’s all it was—
just a pure, simple wish.

Maybe the heavens were moved
by that little display of courage,
’cause down came a staff,
entrusted to the tortoise.

“I’ll use this to help everyone,”
thought the tortoise.

And so, he set off on a journey,
staff in hand,
and his childhood friend,
the hare, in tow.

Upon hearing this,
the hare worried
he might be biting off
more than he could chew.

He was the kind of guy
who never thought about
his own well-being,
who didn’t care
if he got hurt.
That’s why...

Squeezing the tortoise’s hand
in her own,
the hare made
that solemn vow.
